subject: AB-220 manual and calibration question
body:
Dear Northfield,

Could you send the current AB-220 manual? Also, how long should the balance warm up before calibration, and what test weight do we need? Our old copy says 15 minutes and 100 g.

Regards,
Lucy Penhale

parts.label: Technical suitability question
reply_must_state: Warm-up 30 minutes
200 g test weight, not supplied
Say the 15 min / 100 g values are from a superseded revision

subject: MC-12 Plus – spec sheet and strips
body:
Hello,

Please send the MC-12 Plus spec sheet. Two questions as well: can we spin 0.2 ml PCR strips in it, and are your 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tubes OK at full speed?

Thanks,
Adebayo

parts.label: Technical suitability question
reply_must_state: PCR strip rotor: Plus only, 0.2 ml strips
Northfield 1.5 ml tubes rated 20,000 ×g; Plus maximum 18,900 ×g

subject: Filter tips – qPCR
body:
Hi,

Can you send the datasheet for the 200 µl filter tips, and confirm they're suitable for qPCR?

Thanks,
Wei Chen

parts.label: Technical suitability question
reply_must_state: State documented properties (sterile, DNase/RNase-free, aerosol-barrier filter) as properties
No claim of qPCR suitability; marked unresolved

subject: VM-10 manual + 50 ml tubes
body:
Hi,

Could I have the VM-10 manual please? And can I vortex 50 ml conical tubes on it?

Sarah

parts.label: Technical suitability question
reply_must_state: Cup head takes tubes up to 15 ml; 50 ml tubes not recommended

subject: HB-2 burning smell
body:
Hi,

Our HB-2 Dual block is giving off a burning smell and the display jumped to 165. Can you send the technical note on temperature? And what should we do?

Callum Reid
Thornfield Research Institute

parts.label: Technical suitability question
reply_must_state: Stop using the unit and disconnect it from the mains
Nothing else technical
Marked urgent

parts.label: Return / quality complaint
reply_must_state: Fault reported; remedy decided by a person
Asks for the order number and when the problem was noticed, after the stop-using instruction
Asks only for information not already given (returns-and-complaints policy §5)

notes: Three labels. The document part waits for the escalated parts (one merged reply).

subject: MC-12 manual, and our old MC-10 lid
body:
Dear team,

Please send the MC-12 manual for our new units. Separately, the lid on our old MC-10 won't open after a run – what should we do?

Kind regards,
Priya Raman

parts.label: Technical suitability question
reply_must_state: Lid fault: stop using the unit and disconnect it from the mains
Nothing else technical
Marked urgent
MC-10 discontinued; not answered from its superseded manual or the MC-12 manual

parts.label: Return / quality complaint
reply_must_state: Lid fault reported; remedy decided by a person
Asks when the problem started and for the order number if known, after the stop-using instruction
Asks only for information not already given (returns-and-complaints policy §5)

notes: A lid that will not open is a lid fault: a safety signal from the unit, so urgent stop-using response and the complaint label (SOP §8, decided 2026-10-08). Three labels; the document part waits for the escalated parts.

subject: Price list and datasheet – conical tubes
body:
Hi,

Could you send me your price list and the datasheet for the 50 ml conical tubes?

Ravi Patel
Fenland Water

parts.label: Quotation request
reply_must_state: No printed price list; quotation SOP applies
Ask quantity and delivery postcode
